Competent Authority for the purpose of registrat ion shall be the Registration Committee constituted by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Inter nal Trade (DPIIT). (ii) Any false declaration and non-compliance of the above would be a ground for immediate rejection of off er or termination of the contract and further legal action in accordance with the laws. (iii) Validity of Registration: Registration should be valid at the time of submission of bids and should be va lid at the time of placement of order. 3) Common IP Address: Bidders may note that GeM is capturing and showing the IP addresses used by the bidder(s).The received bids having matching /common IP Addresses shall be outrightly rejected and shall n ot be considered for further evaluation. 4) For any Tender related queries, please contact Purchase & Stores Officer, ISRO HQ, Bangalore, Ph;0802 2172142/2248, email: pso_isrohq@isro.gov.in quoting our internal reference number 2026004373 5) For any supply related queries, kindly contact our Stores, Ph: 080-2217-2005/2247/2267. 6) Order copies of similar procurement,GST certificate, Income Tax returns, Annual turnover of year 22-23, 23-24 shall be enclosed for reference. Documentary proof for the above may be enclosed. 7). ISRO Headquarters e-PBG details are:- i. e-BG UIN Number - NCTGC2537P (ISRO HEADQUARTERS) ii. E-mail Id - SAOISROHQ@ISRO.GOV.IN iii. Mobile no. - 9611555677 iv. Registered Entity - ISRO HEADQUARTERS v. Name of Beneficiary - SENIOR ACCOUNTS OFFICER, ISRO HQ vi. IFSC Code - SBIN0009042 8) The bidder shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the existing 2x30kVA UPS Syst em i.e., M/s. Power One Micro Systems Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore. (or) authorized service providers of OEM o nly. To this effect, tenderers/ authorized service providers shall submit authorization letter to carry ou t the work from OEM at the time of bidding. The tenders/ offers of those who have not submitted the a uthorization letter would be summarily rejected. SCOPE OF WORK FOR CAMSC OF 2 × 30kVA UPS SYSTEM AT ISRO HQ, ANTARIKSH BHAVAN, BE NGALURU 1) The Contractor shall carryout Preventive Maintenance Services once in a quarter and shall attend to unlimited number of breakdown/maintenance calls as and when required. 2) Detailed service report shall be prepared and got signed by Engineer-in-Charge (EIC) for every visit after the service.

3) The preventive maintenance (PM) shall include: Ø Cleaning of UPS and batteries. Ø Checking fitment of internal and external hardware and heating of the system. Ø Checking the working condition of tripping and alarm devices of the UPS System. Ø Measuring and recording of all parameters of UPS and batteries (Voltages, Current etc.). Ø All the electrical contact points and connections should be checked and minor adjustments shall be made if found necessary. Ø All the components should be checked thoroughly and it should be ensured that all the operations o f UPS is in good working condition. Ø The Capacitors have to be checked periodically and if it is required to replace, the same has to be r eplaced at free of cost. 4) The contract is comprehensive in nature and shall include repair & replacement of all spare parts / s ub-assemblies complete as required to keep the UPS in good working condition except Transformer & replacement of batteries. Replacement of any component shall be done in consultation and app roval of Engineer-in-charge. 5) The breakdown calls (via email/telephone) shall be attended within 08hrs from the time of service/C omplaint request and the remedial resolution shall be provided within 48hrs from the time of Service/ complaint / Telephonic support. 6) The CAMSC includes corrective & remedial maintenance, setting right the malfunctioning of the UPS system. For effective operation of the system, a standby suitable capacity UPS shall be provided as a STOP-GAP arrangement if the problem not resolved within permissible resolution time as indicated els ewhere. 7) If required, the contractor may take the spare parts/ components to the authorized service centre/ w orkshop for repair, get the parts/ components repaired and re-install back the same without any extra cost to the Department. 8) In case, the spare parts/ components cannot be repaired, the contractor shall get the defective parts replaced with new and genuine spares of the OEM make only during the service period without any ex tra cost to the Department. Repairing/rectification locally by any unauthorized agency will not be acce pted. The defective parts removed after fixing the new parts on free of charge basis shall be the prop erty of Contractor. 9) As and when replacement of spares are arranged, the same shall be done only after entering in the r egister and vice versa. The defective parts removed shall be entered in the register duly approved by Engineer-in-charge before they are taken out of the Department premises. 10) The service personnel shall carry complete set of equipment/ tools & tackles while carrying out prev entive maintenance and attending to any breakdown calls & repairs. 11) Well experienced qualified Engineer and suitable Technicians are to be deputed by the Contractor fo r Maintenance of the units and for attending Break down Calls. 12) Checking all the entries in the event log since the previous inspection and necessary action to be tak en as per log entry to keep the UPS in working condition. 13) All OEM instructions shall be followed while carrying out preventive maintenance, checking, cleaning , operation and during sensitivity adjustments of UPS system. 14) The UPS shall be maintained in good working condition till the completion of the CAMSC. GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS: 1) The bidder shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the existing 2x30kVA UPS System i.e., M/s. Power One Micro Systems Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore. (or) authorized servic e providers of OEM only. To this effect, tenderers/ authorized service providers shall subm it authorization letter to carry out the work from OEM at the time of bidding. The tenders/ offers of those who have not submitted the authorization letter would be summarily reject ed. 2) Pro rata quarterly payment shall be made after satisfactory completion of service for the respective quarter and against submission of Bills & Service Reports duly

certified by the Focal point / Engineer- in- charge from ISRO HQ 3) The contractor has to depute technically qualified & experienced engineer and suitable technicians f or carrying out breakdown calls, repairs and the maintenance work/ activities. 4) Adequate safety measures shall be adopted by the deputed service personnel while working at site. 5) The Department shall not be responsible for any damages, losses, claims, financial or other injury to any personnel deployed by Contractor in the course of their performing the functions/duties, or for pa yment towards any compensation. 6) Department being a High Security zone, the Service Engineer deployed by the contractor shall follow all the security requirements and shall possess a valid ID card during their visit and maintain high ord er of discipline while on duty. 7) The Contractor has to make his own arrangement for transport of his personnel and equipment inclu ding the units handed over for servicing and maintenance to workshop in case of need and bringing it back to Department premises. 8) The Contractor/ service personnel working at site shall abide by the rules and security regulations of the Department issued from time to time. 9) The contractor shall be solely responsible for the redressal of grievances / resolution of disputes rela ting to service personnel deployed for maintenance. The Department shall in no way, be responsible f or settlement of such issue whatsoever. 10) Downtime Compensation: Contractor shall attend to unlimited number of breakdown calls and re ctify the system within 48 hours of intimation. In case of delay in carrying out the quarterly preventive maintenance/ breakdown calls are not repaired within 48 hours of lodging the complaint/ intimation, d own-time compensation @ 0.5% of quarterly CAMSC charges (applicable to each equipment) per wee k shall be recovered from the contractor with a capping of 5% of Annual CAMSC charges. ***** . 3.
